name: AKT serine/threonine kinase 3

function.text: AKT3 encodes RAC-gamma serine/threonine-protein kinase. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant); megalencephaly-polymicrogyria-polydactyly-hydrocephalus syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Cutaneous Melanoma; Prostate. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
